property_summary: For any caller, when the contract is constructed with the test runner as owner, invoking OpenToThePublic() from the owner address will set openToPublic to true (the reference allows owner to open to public), whereas the mutant inverts the owner check and prevents the owner from successfully opening the contract (openToPublic stays false) for at least some inputs.
change_summary: Modify onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner instead of equality, inverting owner check and preventing owner from opening to public.
